title: Create TS/Go prompt parity golden tests
objective: Add golden tests and fixtures that lock down prompt parity assumptions and make regressions easy to diagnose.
context: Current Go prompt tests mostly assert that certain substrings exist.
Parity work needs tests that verify block order, context injection position, cache scope, and memory-file behavior.
The tests should not require network access or executing the TypeScript application.
deliverables: Add fixtures for empty directory, git repository, multi-level memory files, rules, custom/append prompt, and MCP instructions.
Add golden files for rendered blocks and context injection output.
Add a diff helper that reports block-level mismatches.
Document how to update golden fixtures intentionally.
acceptance: Tests fail with a clear block name or field when output drifts.
Every P0 prompt task has at least one relevant fixture or golden assertion.
non_goals: Do not require Bun, Node, or the TS runtime in CI.
Do not duplicate huge original prompt text in every test.
Do not implement missing parity behavior in this task except as needed to make tests compile.
handoff_notes: Use compact golden snapshots with stable metadata to avoid brittle whitespace-only failures.
